capture_conversion: Pillow 12.3.0. Decode each cited JPEG, convert to RGB and save as PNG with compress_level=9. No scene edits, crop or scaling.

alt.en: GeoCeDG Desktop shows the toolbars, Algebra, Graphics, Construction Protocol and Algebra Input.
alt.es: GeoCeDG Desktop muestra las barras de herramientas, Álgebra, Gráficos, el Protocolo de construcción y la Entrada algebraica.

caption.en: GeoCeDG Desktop in English. Algebra and the Construction Protocol are to the left of the drawing. Algebra Input is below it.
caption.es: Captura de GeoCeDG Desktop en inglés. Álgebra y el Protocolo de construcción están a la izquierda del dibujo. La Entrada algebraica se encuentra debajo.

figures.purpose: Locate the tools, Algebra, Graphics, Construction Protocol and command input.
figures.provenance: Computer Use, GeoCeDG Desktop 1.1.0 on the verified CU9 baseline, English UI.
figures.procedure: Open Construction Protocol in the View menu and create the spline through four points. Use A=(-2.7,1.04), B=(-0.96,3.34), C=(1.54,1.92), D=(3.72,3.8), a slider d=3 and the Spline V2 with degree tool. Use the English Desktop profile.
figures.rights: Captured by GeoCeDG contributors. Contains inherited GeoGebra UI material; see LICENSES/GeoGebra-License-2025-11.md and LICENSES/CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.txt. The figure does not add authorization to redistribute the product.

alt.en: A search in the English edition highlights a match in section 9.2 and selects the section in the guide tree.
alt.es: Una búsqueda en la edición inglesa resalta una coincidencia en la sección 9.2 y selecciona la sección en el árbol de la guía.

caption.en: Guide window in English. The selected search result highlights the match in the text and selects its section in the tree.
caption.es: Captura de la guía en inglés. El resultado seleccionado resalta la coincidencia en el texto y marca su sección en el árbol.

figures.purpose: Relate the search match to the highlighted text and selected tree section.
figures.provenance: Computer Use, GeoCeDG Desktop 1.1.0 on the verified CU9 baseline, English UI.
figures.procedure: In the English CU9 Desktop guide, use Ctrl+F, enter PERIODIC COMPONENT and click the first search result. The capture shows the verified CU9 baseline.
figures.rights: Captured by GeoCeDG contributors. Contains inherited GeoGebra UI material; see LICENSES/GeoGebra-License-2025-11.md and LICENSES/CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.txt. The figure does not add authorization to redistribute the product.

alt.en: The Spline V2 degree dialog shows d, the number selected in Algebra.
alt.es: El campo del grado de Spline V2 muestra d, el número elegido en Álgebra.

caption.en: GeoCeDG Desktop in English. The degree field contains the name d captured from Algebra.
caption.es: Captura de GeoCeDG Desktop en inglés. El campo del grado contiene el nombre d capturado desde Álgebra.

figures.purpose: Show where the existing degree variable is inserted in a tool dialog.
figures.provenance: Computer Use, GeoCeDG Desktop 1.1.0 on the verified CU9 baseline, English UI.
figures.procedure: Start with the same four points and d=3 as interface-desktop. Choose Spline V2 with degree, select A/B/C/D/A, click Pick object and then select d in Algebra.
figures.rights: Captured by GeoCeDG contributors. Contains inherited GeoGebra UI material; see LICENSES/GeoGebra-License-2025-11.md and LICENSES/CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.txt. The figure does not add authorization to redistribute the product.

alt.en: Two documents feed a separate trial drawing. Confirming transfers the additions into the current drawing. Cancelling keeps the current drawing as it was.
alt.es: Dos documentos alimentan un ensayo en una copia. Confirmar incorpora sus objetos al dibujo actual. Cancelar conserva el dibujo actual.

caption.en: Expert insertion diagram. 1. Choose a source. 2. Review the trial on a copy. 3. Confirm an available insertion or cancel.
caption.es: Esquema de inserción experta. 1. Elija un origen. 2. Revise el ensayo en una copia. 3. Confirme una inserción disponible o cancele.

figures.purpose: Show the review step before committing an expert insertion.
figures.provenance: Original explanatory illustration by GeoCeDG contributors.
figures.procedure: Guide §4.2 and expert-document-insertion-candidate.md. Symbols represent the source, the receiver copy, review and confirmation or cancellation.
figures.rights: CC-BY-4.0, GeoCeDG contributors. DejaVu Sans glyphs are rasterized; no font file is shipped with the figure.

alt.en: Two views show a horizontal spline at h=0 and h=2. Points P and Q move up with it and keep their places along the curve.
alt.es: Dos vistas muestran una spline horizontal en h=0 y h=2. P y Q suben con la curva y conservan sus posiciones en ella.

caption.en: Diagram of the spline from section 7.5. Changing h moves the curve and its associated points together.
caption.es: Esquema de la spline de la sección 7.5. Al cambiar h, la curva y sus puntos asociados se desplazan juntos.

figures.purpose: Show the point address retained while a curve translates.
figures.provenance: Original explanatory illustration by GeoCeDG contributors.
figures.procedure: Guide §7.5. P and Q use parameters 0.25 and 0.75 on the straight spline; vary h to translate it without changing those parameters.
figures.rights: CC-BY-4.0, GeoCeDG contributors. DejaVu Sans glyphs are rasterized; no font file is shipped with the figure.

alt.en: A line spline and a unit circle have two crossings. The second panel shows a constructed point X at the selected left crossing.
alt.es: Una spline recta y una circunferencia unitaria se cruzan dos veces. El segundo panel muestra el punto X creado en el cruce izquierdo.

caption.en: Diagram of the example in section 8.2. Inspect both crossings, select the left solution and create a point to use it in the drawing.
caption.es: Esquema del ejemplo de la sección 8.2. Inspeccione los dos cruces, seleccione la solución izquierda y cree un punto para usarlo en el dibujo.

figures.purpose: Show how an eligible solution becomes a point.
figures.provenance: Original explanatory illustration by GeoCeDG contributors.
figures.procedure: Guide §§8.2 and 8.4. Use the straight spline and the unit circle from the example; inspect the two solutions and select the one at (-1,0).
figures.rights: CC-BY-4.0, GeoCeDG contributors. DejaVu Sans glyphs are rasterized; no font file is shipped with the figure.

alt.en: Three unit circles show the forward arc across the seam, the reverse arc and a full turn from A.
alt.es: Tres circunferencias unitarias muestran el arco de avance por la unión, el arco inverso y una vuelta completa desde A.

caption.en: Diagram of the periodic example. F crosses the seam at ±π, R follows the other arc, and C makes one turn back to A.
caption.es: Esquema del ejemplo periódico. F cruza la unión en ±π, R recorre el otro arco y C da una vuelta hasta volver a A.

figures.purpose: Compare both travel directions and the full turn.
figures.provenance: Original explanatory illustration by GeoCeDG contributors.
figures.procedure: Guide §9.2. On a unit circle start at parameter 2.5, end at -2.5, and use the F, R and C queries. The lengths are 2π-5, 5 and 2π.
figures.rights: CC-BY-4.0, GeoCeDG contributors. DejaVu Sans glyphs are rasterized; no font file is shipped with the figure.

alt.en: Before and after a pan, fixed panel F stays in the same place. Panel W moves with the axes and keeps its size.
alt.es: Antes y después de desplazar la vista, el panel fijo F permanece en el mismo sitio. El panel W se mueve con los ejes y conserva su tamaño.

caption.en: Diagram of a pan in Graphics 1. F is fixed to the window. W is anchored to the canvas.
caption.es: Esquema de un desplazamiento en Gráficos 1. F está fijo a la ventana. W está vinculado al lienzo.

figures.purpose: Show which parts move when the drawing is panned.
figures.provenance: Original explanatory illustration by GeoCeDG contributors.
figures.procedure: Guide §12.6 and control-layout-v1.md. Pan Graphics 1 with a window-fixed panel and a canvas-anchored panel; only the canvas panel follows the drawing.
figures.rights: CC-BY-4.0, GeoCeDG contributors. DejaVu Sans glyphs are rasterized; no font file is shipped with the figure.

alt.en: The control layout manager shows the slider d as a member of a panel after the drawing is reopened.
alt.es: El gestor de disposición muestra el deslizador d como miembro de un panel al volver a abrir el dibujo.

caption.en: GeoCeDG Desktop in English. After reopening the drawing, the control manager still lists the slider d in the panel.
caption.es: Captura de GeoCeDG Desktop en inglés. Al volver a abrir el dibujo, el gestor sigue mostrando el deslizador d en el panel.

figures.purpose: Identify the panel selector, its associated control and the management actions.
figures.provenance: Computer Use, GeoCeDG Desktop 1.1.0 on the verified CU9 baseline, English UI.
figures.procedure: Open the archived .cedg source model in GeoCeDG, select Move in Graphics 1 and open View → Visibility and style → Control layout. Select the existing panel.
